title: Kirby Problem 1.4
exact_target: A nontrivial satellite pattern with nonzero winding should force more crossing changes than its winding number, for every nontrivial companion.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 2663 (KP-1.4). CC BY 4.0.
